add_card-label: "Can you label card 123 with the urgent label?" "Can you add label id 5 to this card?" "Can you put the blue label on card ABC?" Adds an existing board label to a card by label id. For taking one off use remove_card-label.
comment_card: "Can you comment on card 123?" "Can you post this message to card ABC?" "Can you add a note to card XYZ?" Posts a comment with the given text on a card. For comment history use list_card-action.
create_board-label: 'create a red label named urgent on board 123' 'add a label called blocked' 'new label with color yellow' Creates a new label on a board with a name and color. To see existing labels use list_board-label.
create_card: "Can you create a card for this task?" "Can you add a card to the To Do list?" "Can you make a card from this URL?" Creates a card in a list with name, description, due and start dates, labels, members, position, or a URL source. For changes to an existing card use set_card.
create_card-attachment: "Can you attach this URL to card 123?" "Can you add a file link to card ABC?" "Can you attach this document as the cover?" Attaches a URL to a card with an optional name, optionally as the cover. For existing attachments use list_card-attachment.
create_card-checklist: "Can you add a checklist to card 123?" "Can you create a packing checklist on card ABC?" "Can you copy the onboarding checklist to this card?" Adds a checklist to a card with a name, optionally copied from another checklist. For existing checklists use list_card-checklist.
create_checklist-item: 'Add an item to checklist 5f...?', 'Add a checked item due Friday?', 'Assign a new checklist item to someone?' Adds an item to a checklist with a name, optional checked state, due date, or member. To update an existing item use set_card-checkitem.
create_list: 'Create a column called QA on board 5f...?', 'Add a list at position 2?', 'Copy list 5f... to a new list?' Creates a new list on a board with a name and position, optionally copying another list. To rename or archive it use set_list.
delete_board-label: IRREVERSIBLE. Deletes the label everywhere, stripping it from every card that carries it across the whole board. To take a label off one card, use remove_card_label instead.
delete_card-attachment: IRREVERSIBLE. Trello has no archived state for an attachment, so this is the only way to take one off a card.
delete_checklist: IRREVERSIBLE. Removes the checklist and every item on it. Checklists have no archived state.
delete_checklist-item: IRREVERSIBLE. Check items have no archived state. To mark one done instead, use set_card-checkitem with state=complete.
get_board: 'get the roadmap board' 'what is board 5abc's description?' 'is this board archived?' Returns one board's name, description, URL, closed flag, and preferences by id. To change those fields use set_board.
get_card: "What's on card 123?" "What are the details on card ABC?" "When is card XYZ due?" Returns name, description, due and start dates, list, labels, and optional actions, attachments, checklists, members, and custom field items. For changes use set_card.
get_checklist: 'What checklist is 5f...?', 'Which card is checklist 5f... on?', 'Show me checklist 5f... and its card?' Returns one checklist by id with its items and the card it belongs to. For item complete or incomplete state use list_checklist-item.
get_list: 'What column is list 5f...?', 'Is this list archived?', 'Which board is list Sprint 4 on?' Returns one list by id with its name, board, closed flag, and position. For cards in that list use list_list-card.
list_board-card: 'what cards are on the roadmap board?' 'show open cards on board 123' 'archived cards on this board?' Returns every card on one board with open, closed, all, or visible filters. For cards grouped by column use list_board-list.
list_board-checklist: 'what checklists are on the roadmap board?' 'show all checklists on board 123' 'which cards have checklists?' Returns every checklist on every card of one board. For cards on the board use list_board-card.
list_board-label: 'what labels are on the roadmap board?' 'show labels on board 123' 'which colors are used?' Returns labels defined on a board with their names and colors. To add a label use create_board-label.
list_board-list: 'what lists are on this board?' 'show open columns on board 123' 'cards in each list on the roadmap board?' Returns the lists on one board filtered by open or closed, optionally with their cards. For cards across the board use list_board-card.
list_board-member: 'who is on the roadmap board?' 'show board 123 members' 'members of the design board?' Returns the members of one board. For boards visible to the signed-in member use list_my-board.
list_card-action: "What happened on card 123?" "What is the activity history of card ABC?" "What comments are in card XYZ activity?" Returns a card's activity history like comments, moves, and updates, filterable by action type such as commentCard. For posting comments use comment_card.
list_card-attachment: "What attachments are on card 123?" "What files are linked to card ABC?" "Show me attachments on card XYZ." Returns the attachments on a card. For adding a URL use create_card-attachment.
list_card-checklist: "What checklists are on card 123?" "What are the checklist items on card ABC?" "Does this card have a packing list?" Returns the checklists on a card with their items. For adding one use create_card-checklist.
list_card-custom-field: "What custom fields are set on card 123?" "What is the sprint value on this card?" "What are the custom field values on card ABC?" Returns the custom field values set on a card. For general card details use get_card.
list_card-member: "Who is on card 123?" "Who is assigned to card ABC?" "Who is working on this card?" Returns the members assigned to a card. For changing members use set_card.
list_checklist-item: 'What items are on checklist 5f...?', 'Which items on this checklist are done?', 'Show incomplete items on checklist 5f...?' Returns the items on one checklist with their complete or incomplete state. To toggle an item use set_card-checkitem.
list_list-card: 'What cards are in this column?', 'Show closed cards in list Done?', 'What is in list 5f...?' Returns the cards in one list, filterable to open, closed, or all. For list metadata use get_list.
list_my-board: 'Which boards can I see?' 'Show my open boards' 'Any archived boards?' Returns all boards visible to the signed-in member with open, closed, or all filters and optional lists and organization. For one board's details use get_board.
mcp_beaver_info: Report this MCP server's identity, mode, and served tool inventory. Read-only, reaches no upstream, and doubles as a liveness probe now that the protocol ping is gone.
remove_card-label: "Can you remove the urgent label from card 123?" "Can you take label id 5 off this card?" "Can you unlabel card ABC with the blue label?" Takes one label off a card by label id while the label itself stays on the board. For adding labels use add_card-label.
search_trello: 'find cards about launch' 'search for iOS bug' 'which boards mention roadmap?' Returns matching boards, cards, members, and organizations with Trello search operators, limits, and model type filters. For every card on one board use list_board-card.
set_board: 'rename board 123 to Q3 launch' 'archive the old board' 'change the board description to planning' Updates a board's name, description, archived or unarchived state, or subscription. To read the current board fields use get_board.
set_card: "Can you move card 123 to done?" "Can you rename card ABC?" "Can you set a due date on card XYZ?" Updates a card by renaming, changing description, due and start dates, marking due complete, moving list or board, setting labels or members, position, cover, archiving or unarchiving, and subscribing. For reading use get_card.
set_card-checkitem: 'Mark checklist item 5f... complete?', 'Rename checklist item 5f... to final?', 'Set checklist item 5f... due Friday?' Updates one checklist item on a card by marking it complete or incomplete, renaming it, setting due date, reminder, member, or position. For current items use list_checklist-item.
set_checklist: 'Rename checklist 5f... to QA?', 'Move checklist 5f... to position 3?' Updates one checklist by renaming it or changing its position. For the current checklist and card use get_checklist.
set_list: 'Rename this list to QA?', 'Move list 5f... to board 5g...?', 'Archive this column?' Updates one list by renaming, moving to another board or position, archiving or unarchiving, or subscribing. For current list info use get_list.
